title: Psychology Facts
hook: 3 mental shortcuts quietly running your decisions.
facts: One: the *availability heuristic*. Vivid events feel more common.
Two: *survivorship bias*. We study the winners and ignore the rest.
Three: *framing*. "Save 200 for sure" won *72%* of votes.
Reworded as "400 will die", that sure option fell to *22%*.
